description: Change of use from dental clinic (Use Classes A1, A2 & D1) and beauty salon (Use Class Sui Generis) to Use Class E for the purpose of a restaurant/cafe and takeaway (Use Class Sui Generis),  for sale of food and drink for the consumption on and off the premises. In addition, minor exterior alterations to the south and east elevations including installation of an extract ventilation system.

decision_conditions:
A full assessment could not be carried out to the
application as submitted in relation to the principle of the development
due to insufficient information. As a replacement use has been proposed to a
consented scheme, market evidence is required demonstrating that the unit has
been advertised on reasonable and realistic terms over a period of two years. As
such the principle of development could not be established contrary to Policy 7
of the Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1 (2024).

Notwithstanding the first point of refusal, the primary function of the use has not been demonstrated and therefore an assessment could not be made whether the primary use would function as a restaurant with ancillary takeaway or takeaway with a small seating area. As such the principle of the development could not be established contrary to Policy 51 of the Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1 (2024).

The proposed extraction ventilation flue which extends 1.0m beyond the tallest part of the roof, is considered an incongruous feature out of keeping with the architectural character of the host property, and its setting within the relevant terrace parade and local streetscene, and would set an unacceptable precedence for future developments within the locality. The proposal is contrary to Policy 53 of the Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1 (2024).

Insufficient detail has been provided in relation to the proposed floor plans regarding the internal seating arrangement and therefore an assessment could not be made with regard to the maximum capacity of the restaurant and how this would impact the residential occupiers on the upper floors contrary to Policy 57 of the Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1 (2024).

The application as submitted comprises of an incomplete noise assessment which established a bassline for background noise from Cathall Road only. However, the application site falls at the junction of High Road Leytonstone and Cathall Road. As such, officers are unable to make a true assessment how the ventilation extraction systems would impact the above residential occupiers contrary to Policy 57 of the Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1 (2024).

The proposal fails to make provision for the storage, collection and disposal of refuse, leading to a potential adverse effect on the amenity of local residents contrary to Policy 57 of the Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1 (2024).

In the absence of a Delivery & Servicing Plan an assessment could not be made how the associated vehicles used to deliver takeaways would impact the public highway as the application site is bounded by double yellow lines and no waiting restrictions at any time. As such, the proposal is contrary to Policy 63 of the Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1 (2024).
